selection_rationale.mechanism_quality: high: local-equilibrium mean reversion with explicit non-trending regime and excursion invalidation
selection_rationale.source_method_fidelity: high: rebuilt policy owns reclaim event, trend gate, stop, mean target, timeout and no-add semantics
selection_rationale.native_source_readiness: high: 1h public BingX perpetual OHLCV is sufficient; no private source required
selection_rationale.expected_move_vs_cost: policy blocks intents unless entry-to-mean move budget is >=1.5x verified round-trip cost
selection_rationale.event_rate: moderate and bounded by reclaim transition plus cooldown
selection_rationale.falsifiability: strong: direction-flip, time-placebo, regime-permutation and delayed-entry controls
selection_rationale.regime_clarity: explicit non-trending local equilibrium vs directional block
selection_rationale.redundancy: chosen ahead of similar range/reversal variants because it has a standalone v2 policy/evidence packet and no pyramiding/execution ambiguity

cost_authority.funding: fail-closed if a completed hold crosses settlement without authoritative funding data
